scope_statement: Independent bounded tradition study of situated autonomous agents: definitions, observation, goals, architectures, execution, metareasoning, learning, interaction, assurance and contemporary translations; all ten declared families examined.
scope_boundaries: Not an exhaustive census of every AI, robotics, control-theory or philosophy publication. Inspected precursors ground the relevant problems; no unique-origin claim is invented.
Full strategic/collective multi-agent theory and the complete AOSE development lifecycle are adjacent, not reconstructed in this lane. Genuine source-supported overlaps are preserved.
Consciousness, personhood and moral responsibility are not inferred from engineering agency or believability; no general metaphysical theory is claimed.
No target repository, prior Evolved output or sibling corpus was inspected. No adoption, target mutation or cross-trifecta synthesis is authorised.
Selected source sections and access limits are declared. The original inaccessible intention article is not used to supply uninspected theorem details.
Current-year search includes actual 2026 papers; simulations, extended abstracts, preprints and updated older-task evaluations are not treated as independent deployed replications.

families.NAME: Agency definitions and dimensions of autonomy
families.QUESTIONS_EXAMINED: What entity acts in which environment? Which definition of autonomy is used? Which powers are capability, permission or merely an explanatory attribution?

RECENCY_COVERAGE.LIMIT: Recent implementations and criticisms test current translation/transfer; they do not redetermine every stable historical concept. No new publication was assumed merely from a proceedings index.

families.DECISION_SATURATION: The model, candidate mechanisms, credible alternatives and material criticisms are represented in the linked records. Remaining uncertainty is declared, rather than converted into an unexamined obligation or a universal property. The unit is an entity situated relative to a declared environment, not a persona. Wooldridge–Jennings’s weak notion includes autonomy, reactivity, proactivity and social ability; Franklin–Graesser foreground sustained sensing and acting in an environment; Luck–d’Inverno distinguish goal-ascribed agents from motivated autonomous agents. These overlap but are not equivalent tests. The synthesis uses a task-relative description of action choice, goal adoption/change, resource control, temporal persistence, learning and human intervention. The expanded vector is analytical, not an ALFUS quotation. Agency, intelligence, autonomy, consciousness and moral responsibility remain distinct predicates.

families.NAME: Environment, perception and state estimation
families.QUESTIONS_EXAMINED: Which observations discriminate action-relevant states? When are they stale, ambiguous or untrusted? What information can safely remain unknown?

RECENCY_COVERAGE.LIMIT: Recent implementations and criticisms test current translation/transfer; they do not redetermine every stable historical concept. No new publication was assumed merely from a proceedings index.

families.DECISION_SATURATION: The model, candidate mechanisms, credible alternatives and material criticisms are represented in the linked records. Remaining uncertainty is declared, rather than converted into an unexamined obligation or a universal property. Write world state as x_t, observation as o_t drawn through an observation process, and the agent estimate as b_t or a smaller sufficient history summary. A belief update b_{t+1}=U(b_t,a_t,o_{t+1}) is an internal transition, not proof that the world changed as predicted. In a correctly specified POMDP, the belief is a sufficient statistic for decision-making; the correctness of transition and observation models is a separate obligation. Time, source and ambiguity are needed only where they alter decisions. Queries, questions and waiting are actions with costs, not an obligatory phase before real action.

families.NAME: Goals, intentions and commitments
families.QUESTIONS_EXAMINED: What is desired, adopted and still relevant? When should commitments persist, conflict, change or end? Is success achievement, maintenance or a proxy?

RECENCY_COVERAGE.LIMIT: Recent implementations and criticisms test current translation/transfer; they do not redetermine every stable historical concept. No new publication was assumed merely from a proceedings index.

families.DECISION_SATURATION: The model, candidate mechanisms, credible alternatives and material criticisms are represented in the linked records. Remaining uncertainty is declared, rather than converted into an unexamined obligation or a universal property. Distinguish a goal condition G from a plan recipe and from an adopted intention I to pursue it. Commitment filters later deliberation and coordinates action; it is not merely another current preference. Persistent-goal accounts terminate on recognised achievement, impossibility or loss of relevance, with conflict qualifications. BDI accounts instead treat intention as a primitive in a different formal framework. Neither logical model is identical to its finite interpreter. Maintenance requires continued satisfaction or restoration within a declared horizon, not dropping the obligation once a predicate becomes true. Concurrent goals need conflict discrimination when their conditions, effects or resource demands interfere.

families.NAME: Reactive, deliberative and hybrid architectures
families.QUESTIONS_EXAMINED: Which representation and decision machinery is adequate? How do alternatives differ in assumptions and cost? What new failures arise at hybrid interfaces?

RECENCY_COVERAGE.LIMIT: Recent implementations and criticisms test current translation/transfer; they do not redetermine every stable historical concept. No new publication was assumed merely from a proceedings index.

families.DECISION_SATURATION: The model, candidate mechanisms, credible alternatives and material criticisms are represented in the linked records. Remaining uncertainty is declared, rather than converted into an unexamined obligation or a universal property. Architecture is a conditional selection, not a ladder. A direct policy can be complete for a sufficiently observable local task. A deliberative planner earns its cost when look-ahead or non-local dependencies matter. A BDI interpreter uses context-sensitive plan libraries and commitment rules for structured recurrent tasks. A hybrid can connect slower planning, discrete sequencing and continuous skills, but must reconcile priorities, state and timing. The 3T paper explicitly permits reduced configurations and does not establish hard real-time execution merely by requesting skill frequencies. Modern fixed software workflows are another credible baseline, not proof that all open-ended agency is unnecessary.

families.NAME: Action execution, monitoring and plan repair
families.QUESTIONS_EXAMINED: What can actually be executed, under which conditions, with what established effect? How are failure, irreversible action and repair handled?

RECENCY_COVERAGE.LIMIT: Recent implementations and criticisms test current translation/transfer; they do not redetermine every stable historical concept. No new publication was assumed merely from a proceedings index.

families.DECISION_SATURATION: The model, candidate mechanisms, credible alternatives and material criticisms are represented in the linked records. Remaining uncertainty is declared, rather than converted into an unexamined obligation or a universal property. An action has a proposed identity and parameters, applicable conditions, execution semantics and an intended effect. The transitions proposed → authorised/applicable → issued → acknowledged → effect established are distinct evidence states, not a mandatory serial software pipeline: trusted atomic contracts can collapse some, asynchronous effects can delay others, and a stop or goal change can interrupt them. Missing acknowledgement may mean either no effect or an unobserved effect; blind retry can therefore duplicate harm. Repair changes means only within the authorised task. If a new destination or goal is needed, that is a separate task decision. Coherence across state, goal and authority is a composition-induced obligation, not a copied named architecture.

families.NAME: Bounded rationality and metareasoning
families.QUESTIONS_EXAMINED: When is further computation worth its cost? What happens at a deadline or resource limit? Can a cheaper timely policy dominate?

RECENCY_COVERAGE.LIMIT: Recent implementations and criticisms test current translation/transfer; they do not redetermine every stable historical concept. No new publication was assumed merely from a proceedings index.

families.DECISION_SATURATION: The model, candidate mechanisms, credible alternatives and material criticisms are represented in the linked records. Remaining uncertainty is declared, rather than converted into an unexamined obligation or a universal property. The relevant comparison is between feasible complete decision procedures on a specified machine and environment, not unbounded ideal rationality. A schematic metalevel decision compares expected improvement in task value with computation, delay, sensing and coordination costs; this is an analytical summary, not a universally computable formula. An anytime method is useful only if its intermediate answer is usable and computation can actually be interrupted. A fixed direct policy or simple stopping rule can dominate a metareasoner whose estimation overhead outweighs its value. Costs and quality should remain separately inspectable even where a local decision uses a scalar trade-off.

families.NAME: Learning, adaptation and persistent state
families.QUESTIONS_EXAMINED: What changes and persists? Which evidence supports memory? How are exploration, forgetting, objective continuity and self-revision bounded?

RECENCY_COVERAGE.LIMIT: Recent implementations and criticisms test current translation/transfer; they do not redetermine every stable historical concept. No new publication was assumed merely from a proceedings index.

families.DECISION_SATURATION: The model, candidate mechanisms, credible alternatives and material criticisms are represented in the linked records. Remaining uncertainty is declared, rather than converted into an unexamined obligation or a universal property. Execution state, stored experience, model parameters, policies, skills and revision criteria are distinct objects. Memory can change future behaviour without weight updates; changing weights need not improve the intended task. Useful experience requires provenance and evaluation, and retention has both relevance and privacy costs. Continual learning exposes stability/plasticity trade-offs rather than eliminating them. Safe exploration must protect people before convergence, not only produce eventual good reward. Self-modification theory provides a narrow predecessor-utility result under strong anticipation and optimality assumptions; it can preserve a wrong objective and does not settle open-ended safe self-revision or corrigibility.

families.NAME: Communication, assistance and delegated autonomy
families.QUESTIONS_EXAMINED: Who authorises which action? What does communication establish? When is control transferred and can the recipient really take it?

RECENCY_COVERAGE.LIMIT: Recent implementations and criticisms test current translation/transfer; they do not redetermine every stable historical concept. No new publication was assumed merely from a proceedings index.

families.DECISION_SATURATION: The model, candidate mechanisms, credible alternatives and material criticisms are represented in the linked records. Remaining uncertainty is declared, rather than converted into an unexamined obligation or a universal property. A delegation relates a principal, a task, permitted means and a recipient; it is not inferred from capability alone. Communication can inform, request or negotiate, but sending, receiving, accepting and acting are different events. Transfer of control must include the possibility of non-response, and a nominal human override may fail through lost skill, absent context or insufficient time. Operational interruption differs from a learning theorem about incentives under interruption. Objective uncertainty may promote deference in one game and fail to do so under different private-information assumptions. Human autonomy, privacy and third-party effects remain constraints that cannot be reduced to the agent’s internal task score.

families.NAME: Assurance, evaluation and adverse consequences
families.QUESTIONS_EXAMINED: What exactly was shown, compared, repeated and measured? Which claims exceed the oracle, model or deployment evidence?

RECENCY_COVERAGE.LIMIT: Recent implementations and criticisms test current translation/transfer; they do not redetermine every stable historical concept. No new publication was assumed merely from a proceedings index.

families.DECISION_SATURATION: The model, candidate mechanisms, credible alternatives and material criticisms are represented in the linked records. Remaining uncertainty is declared, rather than converted into an unexamined obligation or a universal property. Evaluation has at least four distinguishable targets: task-instance effects, policy/constraint compliance, repeated-trial dependability and transfer to a target setting. A correct answer can occur without action; a terminal database state can match while a required confirmation never occurred. A theorem is conditional on a model, an implementation relation and environmental assumptions. An observed failure outside those assumptions is not a logical refutation, but it can invalidate a deployment claim. Repetition, reset conditions, shared datasets and hidden human support determine what statistical or comparative claims are warranted. A 50% task horizon measured on human expert task time is not autonomous uptime.

families.NAME: Contemporary language-model agents as a translation
families.QUESTIONS_EXAMINED: Which older mechanisms are translated into language-model systems, which assumptions change, and what do current experiments actually establish?

RECENCY_COVERAGE.LIMIT: Recent implementations and criticisms test current translation/transfer; they do not redetermine every stable historical concept. No new publication was assumed merely from a proceedings index.

families.DECISION_SATURATION: The model, candidate mechanisms, credible alternatives and material criticisms are represented in the linked records. Remaining uncertainty is declared, rather than converted into an unexamined obligation or a universal property. ReAct interleaves generated reasoning/action with observations; Reflexion uses evaluator feedback and text memory without weight updates; SayCan combines language relevance with learned skill affordances. These mechanisms have genuine intersections with earlier planning, memory and perception/action research but do not by themselves implement formal BDI. Tool text creates an instruction-integrity problem: data can try to impersonate authority. Current studies include controlled benchmarks, qualitative user studies, conceptual shared-autonomy work, simulator safety learning and a recent physical-agent preprint; their evidence roles and versions are kept separate. None replaces the pre-LLM genealogy or establishes universal ongoing autonomy.

Full proofs referred to a separate technical report, not independently verified here. Perfect rationality/prediction and modification-independent utility/belief assumptions are strong. Reward/percept tampering, corrigibility and continued value learning remain distinct concerns.

saturation_rationale.STOPPING_RULE: Decision saturation within the explicit scope, not a source-count or property-count quota. Each family has inspected anchors, material objections, alternatives and transfer limits. Further identified leads either supply metadata only, duplicate already-addressed mechanisms, or remain explicit access/evidence boundaries.
LATE_DECISION_CHANGES: Maintenance and concurrent-goal readings justified separate EAA-011 and EAA-012.
Negative reflection results made EAA-054 conditional and EAA-061 superseded.
The partially observable off-switch game made EAA-042 contested rather than a general deference guarantee.
The formal self-modification reading added EAA-070 and narrowed, but did not settle, EAA-062.
Task-instance completion verification from evaluation was adjudicated duplicate EAA-065 of EAA-023 rather than silently deleted.
Asynchronous execution, failure attribution and task-preserving repair warranted EAA-067–069 as explicitly analytical composition-induced records.
saturation_rationale.SCOPE_LIMIT: A frozen bounded study is open to future contrary evidence and new editions. It is not a claim that no relevant publication was missed or that the entire composed architecture has been empirically validated.
